statuses.retained: same identifier in v4; the record content changed but the identity did not
statuses.replaced: one successor under a new identifier
statuses.split: more than one successor: one published identifier named several things

new_in_v4.note: v4 records that supersede no published identifier, by record directory. The seven powders and the material lot are new descriptions rather than replacements - v1's nine 'material specs' were electrode products and map to electrode specs instead. The Topsoe organization record is written to records/organization/topsoe/ in the shared corpus and is not counted here.
